findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_applications, get_application, upload_resume · Private data: list_applications, upload_resume, save_answer, answer_screening_question, apply_to_job, approve_application · Public sink: get_profile, update_profile, upload_resume, send_feedback, answer_screening_question, apply_to_job, approve_application · Destructive: get_job, get_application, save_answer, answer_screening_question.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_applications, get_application, upload_resume · Private data: list_applications, upload_resume, save_answer, answer_screening_question, apply_to_job, approve_application · Public sink: get_profile, update_profile, upload_resume, send_feedback, answer_screening_question, apply_to_job, approve_application · Destructive: get_job, get_application, save_answer, answer_screening_question

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
